name: Evangelical Free Church of America
source_policy: Official EFCA sources only (efca.org): Statement of Faith, Distinctives, mission, theological positions, and the 2017 sexuality and marriage resolution.

evidence.quote: As the verbally inspired Word of God, the Bible is without error in the original writings, the complete revelation of His will for salvation, and the ultimate authority by which every realm of human knowledge and endeavor should be judged.
we are committed to the inerrancy and authority of the Bible and the essentials of the gospel.
We believe that Jesus Christ is God incarnate, fully God and fully man, one Person in two natures.
We believe that the true church comprises all who have been justified by God's grace through faith alone in Christ alone.
The EFCA does not ordain women, which is a general conference decision (1988) based on our understanding of the biblical text
This credential is designed for qualified males who serve in pastoral ministry in the local church whose primary ministry responsibility is preaching and teaching the Word.
Women can and do serve in vocational ministry, and the EFCA recognizes this by offering a Certificate of Christian Ministry

women usually do not serve as an elder in the EFCA, as most EFCA churches recognize that the biblical qualifications for the pastor (serving vocationally in this capacity) are the same qualifications for all other elders as well
even though there is no official EFCA policy for local churches
because of our congregational form of church government, the local church is free to make its own decision on this matter.
Second, God has designed marriage to be a covenantal relationship between one man and one woman.
First, God created human beings uniquely in his image as male and female
the EFCA will not credential one who engages in homosexual conduct or one who does not believe that homosexual behavior is sinful, even though remaining celibate.
our mission is to glorify God by multiplying transformational churches among all people.
The Evangelical Free Church of America is an association of autonomous churches united around these theological convictions
affirms the right of each local church to govern its own affairs with a spirit of interdependency with other churches.

verified_congregations.quote: We joined the EFCA in 1994 and are part of the Eastern District.
